summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp., a Marshall Islands-incorporated tanker owner listed in New York (ECO) and Oslo (OET), filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit containing a press release dated November 5, 2026, that invites investors to a third-quarter 2026 results webcast. The company will report unaudited condensed results after the NYSE close on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, with the webcast scheduled for 14:30 CET on Thursday, November 12, 2026; materials will be posted to the Investor Relations site beforehand. No terms, board actions, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, so it offers no risk-arbitrage angle beyond the upcoming quarterly disclosure.
